test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a drought-tolerant crop?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Millet.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Millets are **a group of highly variable small-seeded grasses.**
 
• Drought is the major restriction to pearl millet as it is grown in the drier semiarid and arid regions. 
 
• But, **adaptive evolution and natural selection made pearl millet relatively the most drought and heat tolerant among other cereals.**
 
• Millet is a good source of** protein, fiber, key vitamins, and minerals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61f6032592d158340cfeb913dd2e02f1955b350ed7fefa3354d69a0015344be9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rice is one of the most important food crops in India**.
 
• Sugarcane is **one of the most efficient crops in terms of photosynthetic efficiency and biomass production**.
 
• Jute is a **bast fibre crop** and can be harvested at any stage after a certain period of vegetative growth, usually between **100 to 150 days.****​ **
